newsitem.title: USA: Louisville feeder cattle prices up $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Louisville feeder cattle prices up $1 - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt higher, compared to last week, USDA said.

Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 72.50-82.50; 700-800 lbs 69.50-78.25. Holstein Large 2 500-600 lbs 62.00-65.50; 600-700 lbs 58.00-65.90, including 20 head 646 lbs 65.90; 30 head 774 lbs 62.25.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 500-600 lbs 74.25-79.00; 600-700 lbs 68.00-72.00. Cattle and Calves Receipts - 2,000
